title: Small words that matter, and the A1 check (Kleine Wörter)
summary: The last A1 words: wissen and kennen, warum, bald, gleich, kaputt, möglich and more. Then check your A1: the final test and the Goethe A1 mock exam.
goals: Use everyday little words: warum, bald, gleich, sofort, mehr, nichts
Check your level: the A1 final test and the mock exam

sections.title: wissen or kennen?
sections.text:
- [[wissen]] = to know a fact: [[Ich weiß es nicht.]] = I don't know. [[Weißt du das?]]
- [[kennen]] (Unit 4) = to know a person or a place: [[Ich kenne Eva.]] [[Ich kenne München.]]

[[wissen]] works like the modal verbs: [[ich weiß]] = [[er weiß]], with no -t.
Russian знать covers both. German splits them, and so does Armenian: գիտեմ is [[ich weiß]] (a fact), ճանաչում եմ is [[ich kenne]] (a person).

sections.title: Little words you'll use every day
rows: I'm not from around here either.
Die Wohnung ist ruhig. Der Koffer ist leicht.
The flat is quiet. The suitcase is light.

sections.text:
[[Warum?]] For now, answer with a separate sentence: [[Warum kommst du nicht? - Ich bin krank.]] A2 adds [[weil]] (because) in Unit 9.

[[Ich bin auch fremd hier.]] is the polite answer when someone asks you the way and you don't know it.

Places you'll need: [[das Geschäft]] (shop), [[die Bäckerei]], [[die Polizei]], [[die Schule]]: [[Die Kinder sind in der Schule.]]

sections.title: Your A1 check
sections.text:
You've reached the end of A1. Two ways to see where you stand:
1. **The A1 final check** (the test at the end of this lesson) mixes all units.
2. **The Goethe A1 mock exam** (Start Deutsch 1): listening, reading, writing and speaking, about 80 minutes. Ask Claude to start it on the PC: Claude opens the exam and the audio, and grades your writing and your speaking answers (typed in the chat).

It's a level check, not a goal. The point is to see what needs more practice before A2.

items.de: Kennst du Eva? - Ja, ich kenne sie.
items.en: Do you know Eva? - Yes, I know her.

items.de: Mein Fahrrad ist kaputt. Kann man das reparieren?
items.en: My bike is broken. Can it be fixed?
I'd like to meet your family.

items.de: Die Bäckerei ist am Sonntag nur bis Mittag geöffnet.
items.en: On Sunday the bakery is only open until noon.
I'm not from around here either.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I don't know.
items.explanation: wissen: ich weiß, with no ending.

items.question: Which sentence means 'Do you know Eva?'
items.explanation: A person: kennen. A fact: wissen.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: See you soon!
Fill in the gap: My phone is broken.
